trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: The installation is very actual and fresh.
trap.right: The installation is very current and fresh.
trap.why: Em português “atual” significa do momento. Em inglês, actual é “real, verdadeiro”; para “atual” use current/topical.

fix.wrong: The retrospective show is derivate and laboured.
fix.right: The retrospective show is derivative and laboured.

rewrite.answer: The show deals with current themes.
